maintenance_led.reason: Sells packaged food brands (Green Giant, Crisco, Ortega); consumables used up, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from grocery retailers, foodservice customers and consumers buying packaged foods, not government payers.

mission_critical.reason: Shelf-stable grocery products; retailers and consumers can easily switch to other brands or private label.

notes: Recent brand divestitures may have slowed acquisition pace, but acquiring brands remains its stated strategy.
